expected_move.basis: the larger of (a) the median of this name's prior reactions and (b) a one-session move implied by 20-day realised volatility. baseline.priced_lean_basis: Sum of the components above. Read eu_priced_in.lean_components(): every weight is a PRIOR borrowed from the US runs, none is measured on European data, and eu_resolve.py ranks each component separately so measurement can replace them. evidence.text: The three Q3 monthly statistics releases put brokerage-generating turnover at about SEK 347bn over 66 trading days (vs 367bn in Q2), with notes/day down ~23% q/q and foreign share ~31%. At Q2's ~11bp gross yield that implies net brokerage of about SEK 324m, against the 323m consensus. The trading-activity line is pre-released and in the bar.
evidence.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2-26 brokerage 349 vs 340 est with op profit beat -> stock -0.7% on the day (Modular table)
evidence.why_not_priced: It is priced. The monthly statistics are public and the 18-analyst consensus (brokerage 323m) already matches the turnover arithmetic. Pareto's preview names 'lower trading activity' explicitly. Filed at 0 to record that the main revenue line holds no surprise.
evidence.independence: Pareto preview 2026-10-12, 'lägre handelsaktivitet vägs upp av högre räntenetto': https://www.placera.se/telegram/avanza-bank-pareto-hojer-riktkursen-for-avanza-till-450-kronor-upprepar-kop-20261012

evidence.text: Avanza's own 2026 cost guide (+9% ex-expansion on the 2025 base of SEK 1,413m, plus SEK 50m Denmark, of which only 3m was booked in H1) implies H2 ex-expansion costs of about SEK 760m (+4.7% y/y after H1's +14%). If Q3 takes its usual ~45% share of H2, Q3 costs are about 340m ex-Denmark, or ~355-365m with a partial Denmark charge, against the -373m consensus. That is roughly a 10-15m (1-1.5%) op-profit upside if the guide is held.
evidence.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q4-24: costs 335 vs 338 est and FY cost growth below guide, with an op-profit beat -> +13.1%. Q2-26: costs 406 vs 398 est (above) inside a beat -> -0.7%.
evidence.why_not_priced: Consensus at -373m equals Q3-25 (324m) x 1.09 plus about 20m of Denmark. That is +9% on the quarter, not the +4.7% H2 run-rate the full-year guide implies after a +14% H1. If analysts had taken the guide at face value the Q3 cost line would read nearer 360m. The other reading is that analysts expect a guide overshoot. That is the downside branch and the reason the range is wide.
evidence.independence: Pareto (2026-10-12) says its 2026 cost forecast is 'i linje med bolagets guidning'. The same source agrees the guide is the reference, but it does not resolve the quarterly phasing: https://www.placera.se/telegram/avanza-bank-pareto-hojer-riktkursen-for-avanza-till-450-kronor-upprepar-kop-20261012

evidence.text: Analysts have under-forecast Avanza's net interest income in recent beats: Q2-26 486 vs 454 est, Q4-24 385 vs 365. Pareto raised 2027-28 EPS 4% on higher NII three days before the print. Against that, the monthly statistics show average customer deposits down ~3.5% q/q (Q2 ~118.8bn to Q3 ~114.6bn) while internal lending rose ~10.5% (30.2bn to 33.4bn) with the policy rate flat at 1.75%. My volume arithmetic lands near the 473m bar.
evidence.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2-26 NII +32m beat inside a 4.4% op-profit beat -> -0.7%. Q4-24 NII +20m beat inside a 7% beat -> +13.1%.
evidence.why_not_priced: Consensus 473m is below Q2's 486m on flat rates and +10% lending. The bar already carries a deposit-driven decline, and a repeat of the under-forecast is not in it. If the market priced the habit, the bar would sit at or above Q2. It is partly offset by the public deposit decline, so it is sized small as an inference.
evidence.independence: Pareto 2026-10-12, 'höjer vinstprognoserna för 2027 och 2028 med 4 procent vardera, drivet av högre räntenetto': https://www.placera.se/telegram/avanza-bank-pareto-hojer-riktkursen-for-avanza-till-450-kronor-upprepar-kop-20261012. Börsvärlden on Q4-24 NII 385 vs 365: https://borsvarlden.com/artiklar/avanza-okade-rorelseresultatet-mer-an-vantat-kostnadsokning-lagre-an-guidning

evidence.reaction_history_on_this_line: no observed squeeze on a print. The largest recent up-move (+13.1%, Jan 2025) came with a clean beat and a dividend raise.

evidence.text: Gothenburg peer Wallenstam's Q3 report (15 Oct, 08:00) showed positive property revaluation (+107 MSEK) and a large derivative gain (+578 MSEK) for Jul-Sep. Read through, Platzer's Q3 should carry flat-to-positive values, a derivative gain on its SEK 11.35bn swap book and a firmer NAV, despite the sector's rate scare. Wallenstam traded about +2.2% on the day.
evidence.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026: Platzer took a SEK -125m unrealised property value hit and still rose 6.7% on the report day (2026-07-03), so the value line has not been the driver; IFPM and lettings have.
evidence.why_not_priced: Partly priced: Platzer is up 0.8% intraday on 15 Oct and +2.3% since 13 Oct while Wallenstam is +2.2% today. If the read-through were fully in, Platzer would have closed the gap with its peer, but after an 11.6% one-month sector index fall it is still near its lows (61.9 vs 68.5 at end Q2).
evidence.independence: Nordnet/Finwire 2026-10-09: the 10y rose from ~3.0% to 3.2-3.3% in September, which is what produces derivative gains (https://www.nordnet.se/blogg/billigt-racker-inte-fastighetssektorn-pressas)

evidence.text: Q3 income from property management should grow year on year against Q3 2025's SEK 198m / 1.65 per share: Q2 2026 was already SEK 212m / 1.80 (+6% per share), the SEK 570m Sörred logistics property was added on 1 July, and buybacks have reduced the share count.
evidence.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: this lands inside the company's own earnings capacity (6.74/share as at 1 July), and the analysts who model it have it. It is filed small because Q3 is seasonally the lightest cost quarter, which the capacity figure does not show.

evidence.text: Ramboll's planned exit from Gårda (SEK 19m annual rental value) was explicitly not yet booked in net lettings at Q2 because formal notice had not been received. If notice arrived in Q3 it lands as a negative net-lettings print, against only small disclosed Q3 lettings (2,600 + 2,100 sqm).
evidence.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 2025 net lettings were SEK -41m (Nordea termination) and the stock still rose 2.77%; Q2 2026's +34m coincided with +6.7%
evidence.why_not_priced: The risk is disclosed but its timing is not. Q2's three-quarter streak of positive net lettings was the headline the stock rose on, so a negative Q3 would break that narrative. Already partly discounted: the Q3 2025 precedent shows the market looks through known terminations.

evidence.text: Capital-return optionality: SEK ~103m remains under the SEK 200m B-share buyback running to the 2027 AGM. Pareto (29 Sep) flags new buybacks after the Q4 Port of Gothenburg asset swap (Platzer a net seller of SEK 684m) as a catalyst, with the stock at about 51% discount to reported NAV, so the report or call may carry a buyback update.
evidence.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 2026 release day (17 Apr), when the buyback decision went out 15 minutes after the report: +2.64% against an index +2.05%
evidence.why_not_priced: No buyback progress has been disclosed since 30 June (no repurchase releases in the Nasdaq feed for Q3), and the stock has fallen 10% in 20 days, which is not consistent with the market pricing an expanded programme. Whether it comes in this release is uncertain, hence the low centre and wide upside.
evidence.independence: Q2 report: 1,334,752 B shares repurchased for SEK 97m under the 200m authorisation (https://attachment.news.eu.nasdaq.com/aaad57f885e8374a06aed93bdc2547cb7)

evidence.why_not_priced: Small (~SEK 2m), three months old and outside the information period that matters. Filed for completeness at a near-zero size.

evidence.text: Swedish market rates rose through September (10y from ~3.0% to 3.2-3.3%) and DNB Carnegie expects average debt costs to keep rising.
